Events

Reaching Out hosts a variety of national and regional events for students and alumni year-round.

Reaching Out is more than ROMBA! For more than 20 years, Reaching Out has grown to include a range of events that educate, inspire, and connect an increasingly diverse LGBTQ+* MBA community. We are proud to offer an extensive portfolio of programming and invite you to join us – and engage with students and alumni throughout the year.

Events.

National Events

Club Leadership Summit

April 10-11, 2026 Dallas, TX

Dozens of student leaders from business school LGBTQ+ clubs gather to exchange ideas on fundraising, working with other affinity groups and alumni, and more!

Learn More

Chicago Trek

June 15-16, 2026 Chicago, IL

The Chicago Trek is primarily consulting-focused, reflecting the city’s strong presence in consulting and advisory firms, while also introducing students to a select group of companies from other industries. Participants will leave with the knowledge of differences between major firms, what opportunities there are to join the workforce, and an understanding of real-life expectations across industries.

The companies participating in 2026 are: CBRE, Bain & Company, Mckinsey & Company, ZS Associates, Roland Berger LLC, Boston Consulting Group, and more to be confirmed.

New York City Trek

June 23-24, 2026 New York City, NY

The New York City Trek is primarily finance-focused, highlighting the city’s leadership in financial services, while also including visits to a small number of companies from other sectors. This trek is a great place for admitted MBAs to increase their understanding of the opportunities that one can pursue at each of the participating firms.

The companies participating in 2026 are: ZS Associates, KKR, Pfizer, Guggenheim Securities, Morgan Stanley, Rockefeller Capital Management, and more to be confirmed.

Boston Trek

July 21, 2026 (one day only) Boston, MA

Designed for admitted MBAs, the one-day Boston Trek features a mix of industries, offering students exposure to companies across sectors such as healthcare, consulting, and life sciences.

The companies participating in 2026 are: Boston Consulting Group, Vertex Pharmaceuticals, LEK Consulting, and more.

Prospective MBA Admissions Summit

August 12, 2026 Virtual

Are you thinking about pursuing an MBA? Join us for ROMBA’s virtual Prospective MBA Admissions Summit and Expo which includes a networking session with current MBA students, panels with school admissions officers, and a Business School Expo with 50+ MBA programs.

ROMBA Conference 2026

October 1-3, 2026 Dallas, TX

The ROMBA Conference began in 1999 and has grown into our flagship event and one of the largest gatherings of MBA students, professionals, and corporate partners in the world. This three-day event blends professional development, networking, and celebration, creating a dynamic environment for recruitment, connection, and growth.
